h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haldia

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Haldia

c: Haldia is an industrial port town on the Hooghly estuary, and most of its open-air gym buyers are the townships and staff colonies around the port and the plants. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to industrial townships, housing colonies, schools and parks in Haldia. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,610 km away, and send them by road to West Bengal.

Township welfare teams usually want one central gym that serves many families rather than small corners in each block. That calls for multi-station frames and double machines placed near the main park or club. Haldia's coastal air is humid and the monsoon is heavy, so the frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded. Fixing is done by our installers or a dealer from the east, either grouted or self-standing. Send us the township plan and photos to receive a layout drawing.

richText.heading: One central gym for a township

items.q: Does the coastal air in Haldia affect outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Humid, salty air is hard on bare steel, which is why our frames are galvanised. Rinse the machines with fresh water from time to time and check moving parts after the monsoon.

items.q: Is a multi gym better than single machines for a township?
items.a: A multi gym saves space and serves many users on one frame. Many townships combine one multi gym with a few double machines placed around it.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Haldia?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India. They fix each machine as per the layout drawing, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
